name: Kachari Ruins (Ruins of Kachari Rajbari)
description: Medieval ruins of the ancient Dimasa Kachari kingdom capital in Dimapur, featuring unique mushroom-domed sandstone pillars and carved monoliths dating to the 10th–13th centuries. Protected by the Archaeological Survey of India; remnants of temples, embankments and baths also present.
facts: Ancient capital of Dimasa Kachari kingdom before Ahom invasion
Famous for mushroom-shaped sandstone pillars up to 15 feet
Located behind Naga Shopping Arcade / near Circuit House

name: Dimapur Town
description: Largest city and commercial gateway of Nagaland, located on the Dhansiri River plains near the Assam border. Serves as the main entry point with airport and railway station for visitors heading to Kohima and the hills.
facts: Main airport and railhead of Nagaland
Commercial hub linking Assam and Nagaland
Best base for day trips into surrounding districts

name: NEZCC Stone Garden and Museum
description: North East Zone Cultural Centre complex featuring a stone sculpture garden with works by artists from across India, traditional morungs, amphitheatre, and a heritage museum showcasing crafts from the eight northeastern states.

name: Green Park
description: Landscaped recreational park inside the State Horticulture Nursery area at 4th Mile, with greenery, boating, picnic spots, and light adventure activities. Popular local weekend getaway.
facts: Part of State Horticulture Nursery complex
Flag: some sources note proximity to Chümoukedima boundary

name: Heirloom Naga Centre
description: Creative hub and living cultural space near Sovima that unites Naga craft brands, workshops, gallery, eatery, and guesthouse. Focuses on preserving and contemporary reinterpretation of Naga textiles, bamboo, and cane crafts.
facts: Founded to promote Naga artisan traditions
Includes gallery, retail, eatery and guesthouse

name: Hong Kong Market
description: Bustling flea market in central Dimapur known for affordable imported clothing, footwear, electronics, and local goods. A lively commercial and social hub for locals and visitors.
facts: One of Dimapur’s most famous markets
Goods often sourced from Myanmar, Thailand, China
Popular for bargains and everyday shopping

name: Dhansiri River (Dimapur section)
description: Section of the Dhansiri River flowing beside Dimapur, offering riverside walks, birdwatching, and views of the plains landscape. Provides a quieter natural contrast to the city.
facts: Coordinates approximate for the urban stretch
